component: Thundermail telemetry preference observer and bridge event

quotes.text: Fires when the effective Thunderbird telemetry state changes

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The experiment computes enabled with every() across the two Boolean preferences. On each matching preference notification it emits that recomputed value, without saving or comparing the prior combined Boolean. Changing one preference while the other remains false can therefore emit false again. The checked background and bridge forward this state without adding deduplication. The schema describes effective-state changes, so consumers must not infer a changed combined value from the event alone. Fixed accepted source retains this trigger contract. This is static source reasoning; native observer delivery, page handling and telemetry traffic were not run.
title: Telemetry preference notifications can repeat the same combined Boolean
